body:
Greg's policy (2026-10-17, via Engram::Advisor b9d13887 #985), verbatim: 'Pytania do mnie mogą być w fazie projektowej. Nie powinni nigdy blokować pracy.' (questions to me may come in the design phase; they must never block work). Questions are recorded with a recommended default and never justify idle capacity. Continue reversible design, tests and measurement, and dispatch other ready lanes; apply the recommended default whenever existing authority permits.
Also (#984): a P1 overdue-handoff fix, TermAl w-d9f93ea08fd2 (design by Architect2 8983). The INTERIM WATCHDOG is a CronCreate job in Fable2's session, firing at :04/:14/:24/:34/:44/:54 (job 2a0557d3, session-only, 7-day expiry). After a session restart, RE-CREATE it.
